findings.class: silent retry after an uncertain write
findings.scenario: POST /products/ returns 503 after the platform applied the create; _call (`if resp.status == 429 or resp.status >= 500:` -> backoff -> continue) blindly re-POSTs up to max_attempts with NO reconcile; a duplicate product is created; ensure_product readback-verifies and persists only the second response's _id (449-455) and the first product persists silently as a duplicate. Same duplication for create_price. The module's own docstring claims 'Timeout/uncertain outcome is reconciled before any retry' and reconciles only TransportTimeout (444-447, 513-516); recipe_transport.py classify marks 5xx-on-write UNCERTAIN ('a blind retry of an uncertain mutation never happens') and capability_inventory.CONTRACTS['uncertain_outcome'] requires reconcile BEFORE retry. 429 is safe-retryable; 5xx-on-write is not.

findings.class: required/hidden field state written but not read back (accurate terms)
findings.scenario: A trial_then_recurring price is created with trialPeriod=7; the platform drops or drifts the trial (trialPeriod=0/absent on GET); _read_price checks only _id, product, amount, currency, type and recurring.interval - never trialPeriod, never intervalCount - so readback passes and the record is returned as 'verified'; NativePrice is constructed with trial_days=spec.trial_days, echoing the REQUEST as verified state; as_price_ref_fields() then hands W8C a 7-day trial the platform will not honor - wrong terms disclosed at checkout. Contradicts the module's own claim ('verify every create ... against authoritative GET/read state; a mismatch is a failure') and spec gap 2 ('set AND read back - never blind-toggle') / Commerce 'accurate terms'.
